name: tendem
description: Codex plugin wrapper for the Tendem MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate tasks to human experts from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Create, manage, and track Tendem tasks through the existing tendem-mcp server. Use this when work needs a human expert for research, data collection, content, design, or task execution.
defaultPrompt: Use Tendem to create a task for a human expert.
Use Tendem to check the status of my delegated tasks.
